source.author: lucan
source.text: Hinc illinc montes scopulosae rupis aperto Opposuit natura mari, flatusque removit, Ut tremulo starent contentae fune carinae.
source.text_original: Hinc illinc montes scopulosae rupis aperto / Opposuit natura mari, flatusque removit, / Ut tremulo starent contentae fune carinae.
source.text_english: On this side and that, nature set up mountains of craggy rock against the open sea and drove back the winds, so that the hulls, satisfied, might stand with trembling ropes.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: quin et Cecropiae proles vacat Orithyiae, temperet ut tremulos Zetes fraterque ceruchos.
reuse.text_original: quin et Cecropiae proles vacat Orithyiae, / temperet ut tremulos Zetes fraterque ceruchos.
reuse.text_english: Indeed, the offspring of Cecrops is also free from Orithyia, so that Zetes and his brother may restrain their trembling oars.
